content: Local-first/own-data pattern: Excalidraw works fully offline as PWA, stores in IndexedDB, no server calls, optional export to Google Drive/Dropbox; MIT self-hostable. Mokuro model = files ARE the database, purely client-side. JSON Canvas demonstrates open portable file format for canvas data. Validates serverless own-cloud feasibility but no existing app combines this with typed profiles + relationship graph + field-scoped search.
